sections.title: Programme admission deadline
sections.body: UCL Computer Science MSc 2026/27: applicants requiring a visa — March 27, 2026 (the page does not publish a separate timezone); applicants not requiring a visa — August 28, 2026 at 10:00 UK time. Because the applicant is a Nigerian resident and the supplied materials indicate current residence in Nigeria, the visa-required window is the relevant one unless UCL confirms otherwise. Both dates are past as of August 8, 2026. The overseas tuition fee shown is £42,700. citeturn0search0turn0search1

sections.title: Distinct university-wide funding deadlines
sections.body: UCL's International Masters Awards deadline was 5:00pm BST on Thursday, May 7, 2026. The award group includes the UCL Global Master's Scholarship and GREAT Scholarship, among others. The Global Master's Scholarship is potentially relevant to an overseas applicant, while GREAT has country-specific eligibility that must be checked on its scheme page. These are separate from the programme admission deadline and are all past as of August 8, 2026. citeturn0search2

sections.title: Funding kept separate from general UCL awards
sections.body: The programme page separately lists programme/department-linked funding and directs applicants to UCL's central scholarships site. The UCL Master's Bursary and Master's Funding Awards are university-wide schemes with a June 25, 2026, 5:00pm BST deadline, but the official descriptions indicate Home/UK-fee eligibility; the supplied materials do not establish eligibility. I therefore have not treated them as applicable funding. citeturn0search1

sections.title: Verification limits
sections.body: UCL's official pages do not publish a separate timezone for the March 27 visa-required admission deadline. I also have not verified scholarship eligibility requiring financial-need, fee-status, offer, or other conditions from the supplied applicant materials. No claim was made that an application, offer, or funding application exists.

follow_ups: If you want a future intake checked, specify the entry year; UCL deadlines can change by cycle.
